# Intro and User Input

This workflow performs single-sample DTSEA-style analyses on compound screening
data supplied in a multi-sheet Excel workbook. It generalizes the original
MIPE-specific analysis by reading assay values, sample annotations, and
run-level settings from the workbook rather than from hard-coded input files.

The workbook should contain a metadata sheet, a long-form assay data sheet, and
an optional sample metadata sheet. The metadata sheet defines the workbook
sheet names, the relevant column names in the assay data, the pathway mapping
library path, and the output location. The assay data sheet should contain one
row per compound-sample observation, with separate columns for the raw response
values and the ranking values used for enrichment. The sample metadata sheet
can be used to provide disease labels or other annotations for each sample.

To run the workflow, edit the `data_sheet` value in the `Input Data` chunk so
that it points to your Excel workbook. The rest of the code can usually be run
without modification.

```{r Input Data}
## ENTER THE PATH FOR THE USER DATA HERE
data_sheet <- "Example_Single_Sample_Data.xlsx"
```

# Automated workflow
## Load Libraries

```{r}
required_packages <- c(
  "dplyr",
  "tidyr",
  "tibble",
  "readxl",
  "readr",
  "data.table",
  "openxlsx",
  "fgsea",
  "GSVA",
  "heatmaply",
  "NewmanOmics"
)

missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
]

if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  stop(
    paste(
      "Install the following R packages before rendering this workflow:",
      paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", ")
    )
  )
}

invisible(lapply(required_packages, library, character.only = TRUE))
```

## Read in data and organize for downstream analysis

```{r}
metadata <- readxl::read_excel(data_sheet, sheet = 1, col_names = FALSE)
data <- readxl::read_excel(data_sheet, sheet = 2)
colnames(metadata)[1] <- "Static"

metadata_categories <- c("Analysis_Name","Root_Directory","Sample_Name",
                         "Compound_Name", "Abundance", "Phenotype",
                         "Transformations", "Mapping_Library")

metadata_list <- lapply(metadata_categories, function(x) {
  metadata |>
    dplyr::filter(Static == x) |>
    dplyr::pull(2)
})
names(metadata_list) <- metadata_categories

path <- paste0(
  metadata_list["Root_Directory"],
  "/",
  metadata_list["Analysis_Name"],
  "_",
  format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d_%H%M")
)

gmt.file <- file.path(metadata_list["Mapping_Library"])
gs <- EnrichmentBrowser::getGenesets(gmt.file)
gs <- lapply(gs, function(x) {
  x <- x[which(x != "")]
})

set_sizes <- sapply(gs, function(x) length(which(!is.na(x))))

if (!dir.exists(path)) {
  dir.create(path, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  if (!dir.exists(path)) {
    stop("Unable to create output directory. Check that the root directory exists and is writable.")
  }
  knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = path)
  setwd(path)
} else {
  stop("Analysis would overwrite existing data, choose another analysis name or delete old analyses")
}

data <- data |>
  dplyr::select(-as.character(metadata_list["Phenotype"])) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = as.character(metadata_list["Sample_Name"]),
                     values_from = as.character(metadata_list["Abundance"]))  |>
  tibble::column_to_rownames(as.character(metadata_list["Compound_Name"]))

if(as.character(metadata_list["Transformations"]) == "z-score") {
  data_transformed <- as.data.frame(scale(data))
} else if(as.character(metadata_list["Transformations"]) == "none") {
  data_transformed <- data
} else {
  stop("'Data Transformation' must be 'z-score' or 'none'")
}

```

## Newman Statistic/GSVA

```{r}
## As of the current version of the NewmanOmics package, p values for the 
## two-tailed (default) test are calculated improperly. We need to
## calculate the p value for the absolute value of pathway expression.
pValCalculation<-
  function(matrix, Background, n, s) {
    Background <- abs(Background)
    meanDist <- mean(Background)
    sdDist <- stats::sd(Background)
    matP <- matrix(NA, n, s)
    for (i in 1:n) {
      for (j in 1:s) {
        matP[i, j] <- stats::pnorm(abs(matrix[i, j]), meanDist, sdDist, lower.tail=FALSE)
      }
    }
    return(matP)
  }

utils::assignInNamespace("pValuesBanked",pValCalculation, ns="NewmanOmics", pos="package:NewmanOmics")

data_transformed<-as.matrix(data_transformed)

gsva_data <- GSVA::gsvaParam(as.matrix(data_transformed),gs)
gsva_data <- GSVA::gsva(gsva_data, verbose=FALSE)

gsva_data_long <- gsva_data |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Compound") |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-Compound)

bank_gsva <- NewmanOmics::createBank(t(gsva_data))

Newman_list_gsva <- lapply(seq_along(1:ncol(gsva_data)), function(x) {
  out <- suppressWarnings(NewmanOmics::bankStat(bank_gsva, gsva_data[,x,drop=FALSE]))
})

names(Newman_list_gsva) <- colnames(gsva_data)

all_GSVA <- lapply(seq_along(Newman_list_gsva), function(x) {
  data.frame(
    sample = names(Newman_list_gsva)[x],
    pathway = rownames(gsva_data),
    NS = as.numeric(Newman_list_gsva[[x]]$nu.statistics[, 1]),
    p.values = as.numeric(Newman_list_gsva[[x]]$p.values[, 1]),
    p.adj = stats::p.adjust(as.numeric(Newman_list_gsva[[x]]$p.values[, 1]),
                            method = "fdr")
  )
}) |>
  data.table::rbindlist()

all_GSVA <- all_GSVA |>
  dplyr::left_join(data.frame(pathway = names(set_sizes), set_size = set_sizes), by = "pathway") |>
  dplyr::relocate(set_size, .after = "pathway")

write.csv(gsva_data_long,file=paste0(metadata_list["Analysis_Name"],"_GSVA_data.csv"))
write.csv(all_GSVA,file=paste0(metadata_list["Analysis_Name"],"_GSVA_results.csv"))

```

# GSEA

```{r}
GSEA_results <- lapply(1:ncol(data_transformed), function(x) {
  ranks <- data_transformed[,x,drop=FALSE] |> as.vector() |> unlist()
  names(ranks) <- rownames(data_transformed)
  ranks <- sort(ranks)
  out <- suppressWarnings(fgsea::fgsea(pathways = gs, 
                                       stats = ranks))
})

sig_GSEA <- lapply(GSEA_results, function(x) {
  x[padj < 0.05]
})
names(sig_GSEA) <- colnames(data_transformed)

sig_GSEA <- data.table::rbindlist(sig_GSEA, idcol = TRUE)

all_GSEA <- GSEA_results
names(all_GSEA) <- colnames(data_transformed)

all_GSEA <- data.table::rbindlist(all_GSEA, idcol = TRUE)

write.csv(all_GSEA |> dplyr::select(-leadingEdge),
          file=paste0(metadata_list["Analysis_Name"],"_GSEA_results.csv"))


```
